name: trackforge
description: TrackForge — personal finance and expense tracking (MERN, TypeScript).

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @trackforge/api" "npm run dev -w @trackforge/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @trackforge/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @trackforge/api && npm run build -w @trackforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @trackforge/shared && npm run typecheck -w @trackforge/api && npm run typecheck -w @trackforge/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @trackforge/shared && npm run test -w @trackforge/api && npm run test -w @trackforge/web
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w @trackforge/api
